That said, you’ve already done more than most. Local vendors, gym partnerships, fundraisers, chamber events. You are ahead of the game, and that matters.

Just to clarify, the event I mentioned is not the strategy. It is not something we build your 90 days around. It is simply an optional celebration at the end for anyone who wants it. If it is not your thing, we skip it completely and nothing changes.

What we are actually building is predictable, recurring revenue inside your medspa. Memberships, package upsells, retention systems, AI follow-up, and staff training so your efforts convert. That is where the real results come from.

You have clearly invested in your community. Now it is about making sure your business is generating revenue that matches that effort.

This program is built around what truly moves your bottom line, and we are with you every step of the way.

Let me know if you have any questions, I am happy to help.

Make this shorter: Thank you for sharing that, genuinely. And I hear you, lots of owners have tried events before without a lot of success with them, so your hesitation is valid. 

Sound like you have already done some of the work. Local vendors, gym partnerships, church fundraisers, the high school business class, chamber events. That is not a small thing. A lot of owners have never even thought to do half of what you have already done. You are ahead of the game in a real way, and I want to acknowledge that before I say anything else.

So let me clear something up, because I don't want that one line to be the reason you hesitate. The event I mentioned is not a strategy. It is not a deliverable. It is not even something we build the 90 days around, just a extra added bonus for those that enjoy them. 

It is honestly just a fun little celebration. At the end of the 90 days, if you want to show off what you have built, the new services you have added, the membership you have launched, the revenue that is already coming in monthly, some owners like to mark that moment. That's all it is. Completely optional. Zero pressure. If it is not your thing, we skip it entirely and that does not change a single thing about your results.

What we are actually building together is the stuff that creates predictable, recurring revenue inside your medspa. Membership architecture. Package upsells. Retention systems. AI-powered follow-up for your lapsed clients. Staff training so your efforts are actually converting. The kind of infrastructure that means you stop leaving $10K, $20K, $30K a month on the table from clients who came in once and just never came back.

That is the work. The event is just a fun bonus for those who want one.

You have clearly invested a lot in your community, and that speaks to who you are as an owner. Now let's make sure the inside of your business is generating the kind of revenue that matches all that effort you are putting out.

I just want to reassure you: this program is built around what actually moves the needle for your bottom line. We are here with you every step of the way, not handing you a playbook and disappearing.

Let me know if you have any other questions about the kpi list or the program. 

I'm happy to help along your journey! 

Warmly,
